notes.title: Crystalwatch Update Live + Sale
notes.content:
Hello friends, the Crystalwatch update is now live and to celebrate the Riverbond Switch launch it's also on sale!

Grab Riverbond at 20% discount until Dec 16! ⚔️


[previewyoutube=rEwcWhECij8;full][/previewyoutube]


Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] World 9 Crystalwatch with new levels, weapons, enemies and boss
[*] New Dance Buttons - Hold L1 or L2
[*] New language support for Japanese & Korean
[*] New Spelunky Guy from Spelunky crossover character in W9 🤠 
[*] 5 new Achievements for W9
[*] Weapon Swapping - Available at treasure chests when all weapon slots are full
[*] Weapons Balancing - Increased damage on Mace and Slap weapons
[*] Added over 60+ new skins
[*] Boss Skin drops after defeating a boss
[*] Treasure chest which previously dropped an assigned skin will now drop a skin from a random list on next play through
[*] King’s Garden map - To view skin collection and pick up influencer skins
[*] Audio balancing for enemies and weapons in Sky Garden
[*] Sound effect fix for entering and exiting maps
[*] Minor map fixes (holes)
[*] Dialog boxes scaling fixes
[*] Fix for audio inversion for L and R channels
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31113757/232345edd56098293c59bea77cea80b957401cbc.jpg[/img]

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Play Riverbond Co-op Online! 20% Off
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Riverbond now supports [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Steam Remote Play Together[/url] -  a new feature to allow you to play Riverbond in co-op online easily through the magic of streaming technology!

Yes, if you've ever wanted to play a cute hack and slash co-op game with friends or family who are not in the same room as you, we encourage you to try out Riverbond with Remote Play Together.

What's great is that only one player (the host) needs to own a copy of the game, and up to 4 players can play in co-op simultaneously.

[b]To celebrate, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/459370/Riverbond/]Riverbond is now 20% off![/url] Please enjoy![/b]

[previewyoutube=ClPgQMi_h8c;full][/previewyoutube]

[u]How to Use Steam Remote Play Together[/u]
[olist][*] Launch Riverbond
[*] Right-click on your friend in Steam
[*] Select 'Remote Play Together' to invite your friend
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31113757/28e52927c3f854bb0d8753433d3cfb23a3c024f9.jpg[/img]
[*] Ensure your friend accepts the invite
[*] Switch back to Riverbond to play with friends
[/olist]


More information in the Riverbond Remote Play Together - Troubleshooting & Tips guide:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1916549611]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1916549611[/url]

notes.title: Crystalwatch - Free Update Coming Dec 10! (Trailer)
notes.content:
We're excited to announced that Riverbond will get a brand new adventure — World 9 'Crystalwatch' — along with a week-long 20% discount on Dec 10, 2019.

[previewyoutube=lMf2yUa6uUk;full][/previewyoutube]

This free update will include a whole new world, with new levels, enemies, weapons and boss. Also, in keeping with the tradition of crossovers, we bring you a new indie game crossover character, the classic Spelunky Guy from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/239350/Spelunky/]Spelunky[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31113757/77d94bd27d305b27c5bebe0df7f75ae5aadcae03.jpg[/img]


Add Riverbond to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/459370/Riverbond/]Steam Wishlist[/url] and enjoy!


- Team Cococucumber

notes.title: E3 2019 games every game confirmed
notes.content:
They just keep coming don’t they? A lot of games were announced at E3 2019, things that we didn’t know about, as well as stuff that’s previously announced, or expansions to already released games. Now, to the casual outsider, what we’re doing might seem absolutely nuts, but we thought we’d put together an alphabetical list of all the PC games that have been confirmed to appear at this year’s E3 show. With well over a hundred of them now in the books, the next year or so looks packed.
